Though this matter has come up for admission,
with consent of learned counsel for parties, it is taken up for hearing.
NC: 2025:KHC-K:7475 HC-KAR 2.
This appeal is filed against the judgment and award dated 29.05.2023 passed by the III Additional Senior Civil Judge and MACT XII, Vijayapura in MVC No.1243 of 2019.

sentences.text: 3. One Sambhaji, son of Dyanoba Ghodake, met with an accident on 23.01.2016 and succumbed to injuries on 20.05.2017.

The legal representatives of Sambhaji i.e. wife and children of Sambhaji,

sentences.text: They also filed the post mortem certificate as per Ex.P.6, but not examined the doctor.
As such, the Tribunal granted compensation for the injuries sustained by Sambhaji to an extent of Rs.6,20,000/- with interest at the rate of 6% from the date of petition till realisation.

Aggrieved with the said amount,
the claimants have filed this appeal.
4. Learned counsel for respondent-insurance company contended that it is for the claimants to prove the nexus between the injuries sustained in the accident and death.
But they have not examined the doctor.
NC: 2025:KHC-K:7475 HC-KAR 5.
Learned counsel for the appellants-claimants requested this Court for remand of the case to the Tribunal to examine the doctor.
6. In view of the above submissions, this Court finds it reasonable to remand the matter to the Tribunal.

7. In the result, the following order is passed:
(i) The appeal is allowed.

(ii) The matter is remanded to the Tribunal with a specific direction to grant reasonable opportunity to both parties for adducing evidence and for arguments and to dispose of the matter on merits by considering the entire evidence on record.
(iii) Registry is directed to send the records in ten days.
(iv) The deceased met with the accident in the year 2016 and died in 2017.
The claim petition was not filed till 2019 and the doctor was also not examined even during the pendency of the proceedings before the Tribunal.
Therefore, this Court finds that claimants are not entitled for interest from 2019 till filing of this appeal before this Court i.e. on 20.03.2024.

NC: 2025:KHC-K:7475 HC-KAR (v) Both the parties are directed to appear before the Tribunal on 22.12.2025.
